status: scaffolding (design + tasks drafted; not yet runnable -- see build_checklist)
mirrors: u3lib/agents/benchmarks (same methodology, SU(4) library and tasks)
prerequisite_library: u3lib (u4lib layers on it; the runtime must expose both extensions)
design: Per task: matched control vs treatment, 2-3 repeats per condition. Start with the hardest task(s), where the earlier u3lib pilots showed the skill package helps.
conditions: control = u4lib with NO agent materials (README stripped of all agent references; no u4lib/agents directory)
treatment = u4lib with the repository-local agents/ skill package (16 skills) + the README's Agent-assisted section/references
condition_workspace_difference: Treatment-only u4lib/agents/ directory + the README agent references; all library code, headers, and tests identical. (u4lib already ships both the agents/ catalog and the README Agent-assisted section; the control workspace is produced by removing them.)
model_note: Mid-tier model, matching the u3lib Sonnet pilots (better than Haiku, far cheaper than Opus). Pin with claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5.

candidate_tasks.01-basis: C++ SU(4) basis inventory: dim, (S,T) branching multiplicities via Zeta, and the U(4) Gelfand enumeration.
candidate_tasks.02-canonical: Python SU(4) > U(3) canonical reduced coupling adapter (wigU4U3db), indexed by (rho, eta).
candidate_tasks.03-physical: Python SU(2)xSU(2) spin-isospin reduced coupling adapter (wigU4SU2SU2db), indexed by (zetaA,zetaB,zetaC,eta).
candidate_tasks.04-recoupling: Python U/Z three-irrep recoupling (u4u6db / u4z6db) with full channel discovery and orthogonality.
candidate_tasks.05-u9: C++ four-irrep 9-coefficient batch exporter (u4u9db) -- hardest; stresses the U4U9 span-lifetime gotcha + six eta axes. Best discriminator, analogous to u3 task 5.

token_metric: claude -p JSON: input + cache_creation + cache_read + output; total_cost_usd recorded too.

execution_protocol.mode: claude -p (non-interactive), model pinned, host-mode isolated temp workspace, fixtures withheld until grading
execution_protocol.runner: a u4 copy of u3lib/agents/benchmarks/runner/run_claude_host.py (paths -> u4lib; runtime must expose u4lib.so AND u3lib.so)

build_checklist: 1. Frozen workspaces: snapshots/{control,treatment}/workspace, each = common.md + environment.sh + empty consumer/ + the u4lib library (and the u3lib it depends on + qcx-utils). treatment includes u4lib/agents + README agent refs; control strips both.

2. Host runtime: a dir with BOTH u4lib.so and u3lib.so built for the miniforge interpreter (u4 initialize cascades into u3), plus a host environment.sh pointing at host toolchain + that runtime on PYTHONPATH. (u4lib.so already built at u4lib/python/u4lib.so; verify it imports with u3lib.so alongside.)
3. Grader: evaluator/grade.py for the SU(4) tasks + evaluator/fixtures-pilot.json with precomputed expected values (generate with u4lib on the host, analogous to u3lib's evaluator/generate.py).
4. Runner: run_claude_host_u4.py (copy of the u3 host runner; SNAP/U4LIB_DIR/PYTHONPATH -> u4; model claude-sonnet-5-5).
